findings.title: Native fatal-error diagnostics escape watchdog lifetime
paths: rust/src/main.rs::native_semantic_command run closure and outer Err arm
findings.evidence: A fast retrieve/send error unwinds the CLI run closure, dropping unexpired guard/controller before outer eprintln(SemanticError). A blocked stderr then has no deadline. Resident returns Err after dropping controller; Result main default termination prints the error after that drop. Successful sender checks and blocked-stdout coverage do not close these fatal branches.
findings.reproduction_design_not_executed: Native child with undrained/pre-filled stderr and fast internal error or broken stdout; assert bounded fatal exit without a second unguarded diagnostic.
findings.fix: Keep runtime fatal diagnostics under active deadline, or omit post-controller diagnostics and return explicit nonzero ExitCode rather than Result auto-print. Keep cold startup exclusion explicit.
